colors.description: Accent, ok and muted light/dark colours; missing values inherit.

emoji.description: One emoji grapheme, without ASCII characters.

extends.description: Explicit parent ID; none stops explicit parent traversal, then embedded Neatpik remains the fallback.

id.description: Optional ID; when present, it must match the filename.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag; English is the default.

lines.description: Voice message IDs, each with an array of variants.

tagline.description: One line, at most 100 characters; no dollar sign or backtick.
